## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- Standard partition filters (nearly all queries)
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'BR', 'PH', 'TH', 'TW', 'MY', 'VN', 'SG')

-- Ads voucher orders only (most common business filter)
  AND ads_voucher_id > 0

-- Alternative: filter by amount instead of ID
  AND ads_voucher_amt_usd > 0

-- ROI3/Cofund pricing type filter
  AND match_voucher_click_pricing_type IN (11, 15, 24, 25, 27)
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- 1. JOIN with AB test user groups (ROI3 experiment analysis)
LEFT JOIN voucher_t C ON (
    A.grass_region = C.grass_region
    AND A.grass_date = C.grass_date
    AND A.user_id = C.user_id
)

-- 2. JOIN with ROI3 whitelist (cofund performance)
JOIN mp_paidads.dim_advertiser_roi3_whitelist__reg_s0_live b ON (
    a.grass_date = b.grass_date
    AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region
    AND a.shop_id = b.shop_id
)

-- 3. Self-enrichment: match voucher click to order via user+voucher+shop within 48h window (write lineage)
LEFT JOIN click_oa ON
    order_voucher.user_id = click_oa.user_id
    AND order_voucher.ads_voucher_id = click_oa.bid_voucher_id
    AND order_voucher.shop_id = click_oa.shop_id
    AND order_place_timestamp - deduct_timestamp <= 48*3600
    AND order_place_timestamp - deduct_timestamp >= 0
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- Voucher cost by user (for AB test metrics)
SELECT grass_region, grass_date, user_id,
    SUM(ads_voucher_amt_usd) AS voucher_cost
FROM mp_paidads.ads_order_voucher_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE ads_voucher_amt_usd > 0 AND tz_type = 'local'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

-- Voucher cost by experiment bucket with cofund split
SELECT
    model_exp_tag,
    match_voucher_click_pricing_type AS pricing_type,
    SUM(ads_voucher_amt_usd) AS ads_voucher_net_amt_usd,
    SUM(ads_voucher_amt_usd * voucher_cofund_ratio) AS ads_voucher_platform_amt_finance,
    SUM(ads_voucher_amt_usd * CAST(get_json_object(bid_rerank_trace, '$.platform_spend_ratio_by_req') AS DOUBLE)) AS ads_voucher_platform_amt_algo
GROUP BY 1, 2

-- Budget monitoring: total voucher cost by region
SELECT grass_region, grass_date,
    SUM(ads_voucher_amt_usd) AS voucher_cost,
    SUM(gross_ads_voucher_amt_usd) AS gross_ads_voucher_amt_usd
WHERE ads_voucher_id > 0 AND tz_type = 'local'
GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date

-- Uplift feature: user-level voucher behavior (order dedup then user agg)
SELECT user_id, order_id,
    MAX(is_ads_line) AS is_ads_redeem,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_ads_line = 1 THEN ads_voucher_amt_usd ELSE 0 END) AS ads_voucher_amt_usd
GROUP BY user_id, order_id
-- then aggregated to user level for uplift model features

-- Voucher discount ratio
ads_voucher_amt_usd / (item_price_usd / 1e5)  -- item_price_usd stored as bigint * 1e5
```

### Snippet 2: Cofund Performance -- Voucher Cost Split by Strategy + Model Experiment

```sql
-- Source: scheduled_tasks/heshiyi/cofund_perf/cofund_base_data/base_data_id
SELECT
    grass_date, grass_region,
    strategy_exp_tag, model_exp_tag, pricing_type,
    SUM(ads_voucher_amt_usd) AS ads_voucher_net_amt_usd,
    SUM(ads_voucher_amt_usd * voucher_cofund_ratio) AS ads_voucher_platform_amt_finance,
    SUM(ads_voucher_amt_usd * platform_spend_ratio_by_req) AS ads_voucher_platform_amt_algo
FROM (
    SELECT *,
        CASE WHEN (match_voucher_click_ab_sign LIKE '%457165%' OR ...) THEN 'base' ... END AS strategy_exp_tag,
        CASE WHEN regexp_like(ab_sign, '457165|477836') THEN 'base' ... END AS model_exp_tag,
        match_voucher_click_pricing_type AS pricing_type,
        CAST(json_extract_scalar(bid_rerank_trace, '$.platform_spend_ratio_by_req') AS DOUBLE) AS platform_spend_ratio_by_req
    FROM mp_paidads.ads_order_voucher_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE ads_voucher_id > 0 AND tz_type = 'local'
        AND match_voucher_click_pricing_type IN (11, 15, 24, 25, 27)
) a
JOIN white_list_t ON a.shop_id = white_list_t.shop_id
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
```

### Snippet 5: Uplift User Portrait -- Daily Voucher Redemption Feature

```sql
-- Source: workflows/ads_algo/model/feature_gen/uplift_user_portrait/.../dws_uplift_user_redeem_daily_di
WITH order_dedup AS (
    SELECT user_id, order_id, grass_region, grass_date,
        MAX(is_ads_line) AS is_ads_redeem,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_ads_line = 1 THEN CAST(ads_voucher_amt_usd AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS ads_voucher_amt_usd,
        SUM(CAST(item_price_usd AS DOUBLE) / 1e5) AS item_price_usd,
        SUM(COALESCE(CAST(seller_voucher_amt_usd AS DOUBLE), 0)) AS seller_voucher_amt_usd,
        SUM(COALESCE(CAST(platform_voucher_amt_usd AS DOUBLE), 0)) AS platform_voucher_amt_usd,
        SUM(COALESCE(CAST(fsv_voucher_amt_usd AS DOUBLE), 0)) AS fsv_voucher_amt_usd
    FROM (
        SELECT *, CASE WHEN CAST(ads_voucher_amt_usd AS DOUBLE) > 0 THEN 1
                       WHEN ads_voucher_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAST(ads_voucher_id AS STRING)) <> '' AND TRIM(CAST(ads_voucher_id AS STRING)) <> '0' THEN 1
                       ELSE 0 END AS is_ads_line
        FROM mp_paidads.ads_order_voucher_1d__reg_s0_live
        WHERE tz_type = 'local' AND grass_region IN ('ID','MY','PH','TH','SG','TW','BR','VN')
    ) v GROUP BY user_id, order_id, grass_region, grass_date
)
-- Then user-level aggregation for redemption frequency, amount, discount ratio, voucher type preference
```

## Write Lineage

### Production Workflow

| Source Path | Partition Strategy | tz_type |
|-------------|-------------------|---------|
| data_paidadsmart/workflows/playground/yawei.zhang/temp_optimize_task/ | Per-region, per-tz_type (local + regional) | local, regional |
| data_paidadsmart/workflows/data_warehouse_us/ads/ads_order_voucher_1d__reg_s0_live_us/ | BR partition add (US cluster) | local |

### Upstream Tables

| Table | Role |
|-------|------|
| mp_order.dwd_order_item_all_ent_df(__reg_s0_live) | Order items with voucher amounts (seller/platform/fsv rebates, GMV) |
| mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live | Click/impression records for voucher click attribution (48h window) |
| mp_voucher.dim_voucher__reg_live | Voucher dimension: identify ADS-ROI voucher groups |
| mkplpaidads_data.item_price__reg_s0_live | Item price lookup |
| mp_paidads.dim_advertise__reg_s0_live | Ads dimension: package non-ads type, pricing_type=29 |
| mp_paidads.shopee_ads_${region}_${db_type}__ads_voucher_package_tab__reg_continuous_s0_live | Voucher package info (co_fund_ratio, campaign period) |
| mp_paidads.ods_log_unified_order_event_hi__${region}_s0_live | Unified order event log (newer write path: voucher_click_context) |

### Write Logic Summary

1. **order_voucher** temp view: Join order items (dwd_order_item_all_ent_df) with item price, perf_di (for ab_sign/placement/ads_id on broad orders with placement IN (40,50)), and dim_voucher (filter ADS-ROI seller vouchers)
2. **click_oa** temp view: Extract click-level voucher context from perf_di (cofund ratio, voucher_details_json, click datetime/ads_id/pricing_type/placement/ab_sign/entrance from bid_rerank_trace)
3. **Final INSERT**: LEFT JOIN order_voucher with click_oa on user_id + ads_voucher_id(=bid_voucher_id) + shop_id within 48h attribution window, deduplicate by latest click (row_number), then LEFT JOIN voucher_package_info for non_ads_type and package_co_fund_ratio
